t.name: Louis Lake Trail
t.description: Hike through a fire-devastated forest to an alpine lake set below steep cliffs with a waterfall inlet.

t.name: North Fork Fish Creek Trail
t.description: This very steep trail within Lake Chelan-Sawtooth Wilderness gains 1,800 feet in elevation over its 3.2 miles. The North Fork Fish Creek Trail ties the Fish Creek Trail #1248 with the Summit Trail #1259.

t.name: Twisp River Trail
t.description: The Twisp River Trail is a great early season trail for mountain biking, horseback riding, and hiking. The trail meanders generally up and down route along the hillside above the Twisp River.

t.name: North Creek Trail
t.description: The first two miles are in burn from the 2018 Gilbert fire before entering more forested areas of Ponderosa Pine and Douglas Fir. The route crosses several avalanche paths and sub-alpine forest before arriving at North Lake.

t.name: Scatter Creek Trail
t.description: This trail enters Lake Chelan-Sawtooth Wilderness and climbs to Scatter Lake. The first 500 feet is roadbed and Twisp River Trail. It switchbacks up through forest with occasional views.

t.name: Williams Creek Trail
t.description: The trail climbs moderately through forest into Lake-Chelan Sawtooth Wilderness to Williams Lake. It then travels across shale and talus slopes and through an old burned area. Trail ends at the lake and sports beautiful alpine larch colors in the fall.

t.name: War Creek Trail
t.description: The War Creek Trail #408 is a historic route that follows War Creek within Lake Chelan-Sawtooth Wilderness to a high pass that has wonderful views of the Lake Chelan-Sawtooth Mountains range.

t.name: Copper Pass Trail
t.description: The Copper Pass Trail #426 from Gilbert Trailhead passes through avalanche chutes and subalpine forest with large spruce trees for the first 2.2 miles. The last mile before the pass, crosses open basins with scattered stands of subalpine forest.

t.name: Cedar Creek Trail
t.description: The trail continues 7.5 miles beyond the falls to Abernathy Pass, where it enters the Lake Chelan-Sawtooth Wilderness and ends at North Creek Trail #413.
